description: Several colorful plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, and green) sit on the table, with a yellow bottle nearby and a blue sponge cloth in front. The left hand steadies and tilts the yellow cup while the right hand pulls the blue sponge cloth out of the cup, then the right hand holds the sponge cloth on the tabletop as the left hand slides the cups into a neat row, nudging the blue cup into place.
